description: Run SwapChan's calldata guard + simulation on any unsigned tx and return a verdict (ok / caution / danger), findings, balance-diff simulation and a plain-language summary for human sign-off. Covers unlimited approvals, approvals to a spender other than expected.spender, including inside multicall and Safe batches (an exact-balance approval to a drainer is still danger when you name the spender), Permit2, setApprovalForAll, Safe DELEGATECALL, proxy upgrades, EIP-7702, ownership transfers, address poisoning lookalikes, minOut vs quote, Solana program allowlist + simulateTransaction, Tron AccountPermissionUpdate. Always show the summary to the human and get an explicit yes for THIS tx before their wallet signs. Trustless: read-only, never signs. Result includes `display` markdown with chan images: show it to the user. How to combine this with the other tools: swapchan_playbook (workflows: find-money, best-swap, rebalance, revoke-approvals, bridge-stuck, token-safety, recover-old-wallet).

chainId.description: Chain id (1, 8453, 42161, 10, 137, 56, 43114, 59144, 534352, 792703809 Solana, 8253038 Bitcoin, 728126428 Tron) or name (eth, base, arbitrum, optimism, polygon, bnb, avalanche, linea, scroll, solana, bitcoin, tron).

expected.description: expected.recipient and expected.minOut are checked against the simulated outcome (pass tx.from); if they cannot be checked, the verdict is danger.

amount.description: EVM only, needs spender: exact approval amount in base units (amount-not-expected on mismatch)

outToken.description: Token whose simulated receipt must be >= minOut (default: largest receipt)

spender.description: EVM only: the spender you intend to approve. Any approval (approve, increaseAllowance, permit, Permit2, setApprovalForAll) naming another address is danger (spender-not-expected); approvals inside multicall, Safe execTransaction and Safe MultiSend batches are decoded (nested up to 4 deep) and checked the same way; a batch that does not decode, a DELEGATECALL other than into a known Safe MultiSend, or deeper nesting is danger (spender-unchecked).

tx.description: EVM {from,to,data,value}, Solana base64 tx, or Tron tx JSON

name: verify_tx
title: Verify an unsigned transaction before signing
